scope: Source-fidelity requirements from accepted 1847-1850 batches 32-34. Requirements only; no converter, transcript, corpus or training output.

requirements.case: Omitted species list and unpublished draft repetition
requirements.requirement: Preserve 1289's six prose blocks and absence of the referenced 73-species list. Keep 1121 as an unpublished draft with repeated argument/enquiry sequences and literal 212-foot wording; do not silently collapse repetitions or import later published conclusions.

source_provenance.locators: div#letter body; six blocks; missing list

exact_source_evidence.quote: I am still inclined to abide by the marine theory
the whole 212 vertical feet of fall in this valley

requirements.unavailable_status: 1289's 73-species list and Dana cover are absent; do not synthesize.

requirements.case: First versus later edition and partial reading
requirements.requirement: Keep the first edition read before 1369F separate from the fifth edition received that morning and still awaiting reading. For 1307, a response proves Darwin read the missing manuscript by 4 March 1850, but does not restore its absent text or diagrams.

exact_source_evidence.quote: since I read it as a first Edition
I shall read your ideas on Education
I have read over your paper with attention

requirements.case: Known-by versus exact arrival and calendar conflict
requirements.requirement: Record 13843 as known by 9 January 1850, with note/drawings safely returned but exact arrival unknown; preserve blank receipts and subscriber list as explicitly absent. For 1195 keep written Saturday 20 August alongside calendar Sunday conflict and do not silently change the date. Chloroform thanks and later loan evidence remain separate.

exact_source_evidence.quote: I received no “blank receipts” or “list of Subscribers”

normalized_fields.1195_date: written Saturday 20 August 1848; calendar conflict retained

requirements.case: Mixed cover, copied proposal, date and voice
requirements.requirement: Render Henry Allen Wedgwood as sender of the 21 February cover and Hensleigh as named principal in the copied 22 February proposal. Keep the relocated forwarding sentence as historical source text, not an agent instruction; separate unconditional Henry allotment from conditional family/financing terms and do not infer Darwin receipt or April purchase.

source_provenance.locators: div#letter body P3-P4; cover and copied proposal

exact_source_evidence.quote: I am authorised by Mr Hensleigh Wedgwood

requirements.case: Incomplete surviving ending and permission versus completion
requirements.requirement: Preserve the abrupt surviving ending and incomplete Loricula description. Darwin's request that silence count as permission is not actual consent or drawing completion; later Sowerby identities and return records must remain outside the contemporary text.

source_provenance.locators: div#letter body; abrupt ending and permission request

exact_source_evidence.quote_status: No short quote asserted: preserve the complete surviving body and explicit truncation marker from the source projection.

requirements.case: Physical letter order and wrong-way-first note
requirements.requirement: Preserve the first-sheet verso note after the body continues on the torn second sheet. It is part of one physical letter, not a new message or instruction. The missing 21 May proposal and exact project remain unavailable; John Allen is the recipient.

exact_source_evidence.quote: I see that I have written this note the wrong way first

future_requirements: Preserve source identity, physical order, missing material, date conflicts, known-by versus arrival, edition/read state, attributed voices, literal repetitions and raw structured values.
Keep copied proposals, cover text, body text, editorial notes and later outcomes as separate layers.
not_implemented_here: No converter, transcript, corpus, ledger, export or training behavior was changed or run.
This draft creates no new historical acceptance and remains provisional for root verification.

notes: All asserted quotations are literal source paragraph text. Values and date interpretations are explicitly labeled normalized fields rather than source quotations.
